title: Chibi Maruko-chan no Taisen Puzzle-dama
native_title: ちびまる子ちゃんの対戦ぱずるだま
overview:
At last, Maruko's puzzle game is here. The rules are simple. Have fun with heated battles with everyone. With the same voice actors as the anime, it's sure to be a blast!

Maruko and the rest of the Chibi Maruko-chan cast face off in this head-to-head falling-block puzzle game. Line up the smiling, colored dama as they drop, keep an eye on the next piece, and set off chains to dump attack dama on your opponent's side. String together enough chains and even Grandpa Tomozo can turn a losing match around.

- Battle the computer or a friend in 1-2 player matches
- Characters from the anime, with the anime's voice actors

ついに、まる子のパズルゲームが登場だよ。ルールは簡単。みんなで熱い対戦を楽しんでおくれよ。アニメと同じ声優で盛り上がること間違いナシだよ!
